title: Spring MVC & REST API Development
intro: Building REST APIs with Spring MVC is the day-one job of a Java fullstack developer. Freshers are expected to understand REST constraints, wire up controllers, validate input, return proper HTTP status codes, and handle exceptions globally. This module covers everything from @RestController basics to production-grade practices like RFC 9457 error responses and @ControllerAdvice — the topics that separate freshers who have shipped code from those who have only read documentation.
